goal: Create a photorealistic three-frame cinematic emotion beat that preserves one fictional young Asian adult identity and one train setting while restrained performance progresses from shock through grief to composure.
audience: Character directors, storyboard artists, and screen-performance teams who need an inspectable emotional continuity reference

content.subject: Three consecutive head-and-upper-torso frames of one fictional 26-year-old East Asian woman seated beside one rain-streaked late-night train window
must_include: Exactly three equal portrait-oriented panels in one horizontal triptych
One stable clearly adult fictional young East Asian identity across all panels
The same right-eye mole, chin-length black bob, navy wool coat, gray crew-neck top, seat, and rain-streaked window
A restrained left-to-right progression from contained shock to processing grief to resolved composure
Consistent cool window light, subtle warm carriage reflection, realistic skin, wool, glass, and eye moisture
must_avoid: Identity drift, apparent-age change, face-shape change, mole movement, hairstyle change, wardrobe change, or location change
Childlike appearance, mature appearance, glamour styling, beauty smoothing, visible makeup, celebrity likeness, or sexualized presentation
Streaming tears, open-mouth sobbing, screaming, theatrical grimaces, melodrama, or a smile in the final panel
Extra people, hands near the face, phones, props, text, subtitles, signage, logos, brands, or watermarks
Cartoon, anime, illustration, CGI, poster design, duplicated panel, or irregular collage styling

art_direction.style: Naturalistic low-light cinematic photography with restrained screen acting
art_direction.lighting: One consistent soft cool window source from camera-right with a faint warm carriage reflection from camera-left

composition.layout: Three equal portrait-oriented panels side by side with narrow matte-black gutters
composition.viewpoint: Eye-level 70 mm head-and-upper-torso framing with nearly fixed head angle, camera distance, and shoulder scale
focal_hierarchy: Continuous train setting and low-light atmosphere

objective_checks: Output is exactly 1536x1024 PNG/RGB without alpha
Exactly three appearances of one adult identity appear
No visible text, logo, brand, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Face geometry, adult age, mole placement, bob, clothing, crop, seat, window, light direction, and color remain stable across all panels
Contained shock, processing grief, and resolved composure read clearly from left to right without exaggerated acting or a final smile
Eyes, brows, lips, jaw, skin, wool, seat textile, wet glass, catchlights, and eye moisture remain naturally photographic
The artifact reads as consecutive frames from one restrained film scene rather than a campaign, music-video poster, beauty shoot, meme, or generic collage
